episodes.title: Bienvenidos
episodes.summary: After a public high school collapses, the builder tries to repair its image by paying for three impacted students to attend an exclusive private school.

episodes.title: Deseo
episodes.summary: A school project brings Marina and Samuel closer, and inspires Guzmán to try and win over Nadia. Meanwhile, Christian is shocked by a revelation.

episodes.title: Sábado Noche
episodes.summary: Samuel throws a party, where Nano makes a move on Marina and spiked punch affects more than one couple. Nadia is hurt by what she learns about Guzmán.

episodes.title: El Amor es una Droga
episodes.summary: Guzmán tries to earn Nadia's forgiveness. Polo and Christian bond at a gala. Lu bribes her teacher. To pay his debt, Nano must complete a dark mission.

episodes.title: Todos Mienten
episodes.summary: Marina gives Nano a way to pay his debt. Lu intentionally leaks a secret in front of Nadia. Omar learns Ander told his friends about the two of them.

episodes.title: Todo Va a Salir Bien
episodes.summary: Nano learns one watch holds a secret. Marina's pot stash is found. News of a pregnancy raises suspicions. Christian is offered fame if he does a favor.

episodes.title: Todo Estalla
episodes.summary: Carla suspects Marina is involved in the theft. Omar's father makes plans for his son. After learning his sister's secret, Guzmán seeks revenge.

episodes.title: Assilah
episodes.summary: The last moments before the murder unfold. Christian makes a tough decision. The police arrest a suspect. Guzmán becomes reckless with grief.

episodes.title: 20 horas desaparecido
episodes.summary: New students start school at Las Encinas as Guzmán continues to mourn his sister and Christian struggles with his secret. A classmate goes missing.

episodes.title: 34 horas desaparecido
episodes.summary: Seeking the truth about Marina's death, Samuel attempts to seduce Carla. Lu's new friend, social media guru Cayetana, hosts an impromptu party.

episodes.title: 36 horas desaparecido
episodes.summary: Polo and Ander have a heart-to-heart. Nadia gets creative to stop Guzmán from drinking too much and doing drugs. Rebeca's mother offers Samuel a job.

episodes.title: 59 horas desaparecido
episodes.summary: Pressured by his friends, Polo's guilt overwhelms him. Cayetana's mother threatens to reveal her secret. Ander and Guzmán argue with their partners.

episodes.title: 63 horas desaparecido
episodes.summary: Rebeca teases Cayetana with what she's learned. The Halloween party takes a troubling turn. Samuel walks in on a shocking scene.

episodes.title: 66 horas desaparecido
episodes.summary: Lu blackmails Nadia, and Samuel confronts Carla with his suspicions. In the future, Guzmán is interrogated about the missing student.

episodes.title: 84 horas desaparecido
episodes.summary: Lu uncovers a secret while helping Cayetana with her fundraiser party. Omar worries about Samuel's fate. Ander's behavior confuses Guzmán.

episodes.title: 0 horas desaparecido
episodes.summary: Painful truths and dark secrets are exposed as the students unburden themselves and the circumstances behind Samuel's disappearance are revealed.

episodes.title: Carla
episodes.summary: Carla is interrogated when a student is killed at a party. In the past, she faces Polo in court, Ander has a health worry, and Nadia meets a new suitor.

episodes.title: Samuel y Guzmán
episodes.summary: Guzmán attempts to make amends. Nadia threatens payback when she and Lu go after the same scholarship. Ander comes clean to his loved ones.

episodes.title: Cayetana y Valerio
episodes.summary: Polo is harassed at school. Samuel mulls the police's offer as he and Rebeca become closer. Ander struggles with his treatment.

episodes.title: Lu
episodes.summary: Guzmán confronts Nadia's father. New romances transpire when Lu throws a creative Valentine's Day party. Rebeca struggles with a moneymaking decision.

episodes.title: Ander
episodes.summary: Rebeca tries to identify the traitor. A blackout party at the club leads to multiple shocking revelations.

episodes.title: Rebeca
episodes.summary: The Columbia scholarship winner is announced. Nadia makes a momentous decision. Samuel's concern about Carla causes issues between him and Valerio.

episodes.title: Nadia y Omar
episodes.summary: As graduation day arrives, the futures of multiple students remain uncertain. Polo begs his mothers to reconsider their recent decision.

episodes.title: Polo
episodes.summary: The events that transpired the night of the murder unfold. The police interview several eyewitnesses who are ready to point fingers.

episodes.title: El nuevo orden
episodes.summary: A stern principal and three new students begin at Las Encinas. Omar and Samuel must prove themselves academically while their friends try to help.

episodes.title: 5 segundos
episodes.summary: Prince Phillipe's arrival at the school prompts strict security measures and controversy. Samuel and Omar's towel party leads to new romantic hookups.

episodes.title: Cuando bailan las mentiras con las tentaciones
episodes.summary: When Prince Phillippe hosts his famous Le Bal party, betrayals ensue. The jealousy between Guzmán and Samuel intensifies. Patrick sparks friction.

episodes.title: Soy una...
episodes.summary: Rebe is confused and hurt by Mencía's mysterious behavior. Much to Ari's chagrin, Benjamín suggests Samuel join the debate team.

episodes.title: La reinserción
episodes.summary: Ari and Samuel face off in an important and public debate. After speaking with Ander, Omar struggles with the emotional fallout.

episodes.title: Te quiero mal
episodes.summary: Phillippe worries that his friends are using him for Ambar Lucid performance tickets. Rebe warns Mencía she feels skeptical about Armando's assistance.

episodes.title: Antes de irme (1ª parte)
episodes.summary: Samuel tells Ari to make her choice while Guzmán plans a romantic date. Cayetana is stunned by a realization. Mencía is backed into a corner.

episodes.title: Antes de irme (2ª parte)
episodes.summary: The details of Ari's attack are revealed but the Las Encinas students prove yet again there is always more than meets the eye.

episodes.title: Yo lo maté
episodes.summary: A new student catches Patrick's eye while another surprises Cayetana by defending Phillipe. Benjamín implements stricter measures at school.

episodes.title: Todo vale
episodes.summary: Patrick lashes out at his dad by hosting a hedonistic party for everyone at the school. Samuel struggles with keeping both Ari and Benjamín happy.

episodes.title: Átame
episodes.summary: Tensions grow between Omar and Samuel as the students vote for someone to be expelled. Isadora tries to persuade Phillipe that she knows what's best.

episodes.title: El cuerpo
episodes.summary: While helping her father with an auction, Mencía makes a shocking discovery. Outside of the event, Omar is surprised by what he finds in the water.

episodes.title: Por favor, di la verdad
episodes.summary: The police investigation forces Benjamín into the spotlight. Patrick finds himself in a tough spot with Iván and Cruz. Caye reconnects with a friend.

episodes.title: No puedes comprar mi amor
episodes.summary: The students auction off dates to raise money for Samuel's bail, but the results of the bidding cause more than one broken heart.

episodes.title: Tóxicos
episodes.summary: Samuel, Rebe and Cayetana look for evidence that could implicate Benjamín. Heartbroken over Phillipe's harsh words, Isadora embarks on a trip to Ibiza.

episodes.title: Tu lado del mundo y el mío
episodes.summary: Samu considers his next move with the SIM card, Cruz gives Iván relationship advice, and Caye tries to support a traumatized Isadora.

episodes.title: Ansiedad
episodes.summary: Ari, Mencía and Patrick return to school, determined not to let their family's baggage weigh them down. Isa's new club opens with a big first night.

episodes.title: Selfis
episodes.summary: After a new development in Isa's case against her rapists, everyone has an opinion. Ari asks Nico out for a drink. Patrick makes a sacrifice.

episodes.title: Desnudos
episodes.summary: Isa's friends rally round — and strip down — to support her. Rocío practices a new talent. Mencía starts to wonder about Sara and Raúl's relationship.

episodes.title: Guerra
episodes.summary: The crew turns out for Cruz's championship football match, where controversy leads to chaos — and then shocking violence. Sara makes a painful decision.

episodes.title: Duelo
episodes.summary: Javi plants an idea in Isa's head that she can't shake, while Patrick struggles to help Iván process a loss. Raúl isn't ready to let go of Saraul.Goals.

episodes.title: Tina
episodes.summary: Iván seeks emotional release, Sara slips back into old routines, and Ari goes looking for closure. When Isa proposes a collaboration, Nico has doubts.

episodes.title: Máscaras
episodes.summary: A Venetian Carnival night at Isadora House shows Isa a new side of Dídac and puts the students of Las Encinas on a collision course toward heartbreak.

episodes.title: Separación
episodes.summary: Still reeling from the night before, Ari takes on the heavy responsibility of protecting her siblings. Hugo's past actions finally catch up with him.

episodes.title: Las Encinas
episodes.summary: An old student is tempted to return to Las Encinas as Isadora struggles with her feelings for Dídac. Iván feels lonely — but that might change soon.

episodes.title: Protocolo
episodes.summary: Chloe and Carmen are both obsessed with Iván — but for different reasons. Coach Jessica advises Sara. The mysterious academic director focuses on Dídac.

episodes.title: Bling‑Bling
episodes.summary: Sara throws a steamy glitter party. Family tensions tear Dídac and Isadora apart. Rocío and Eric's night in the squatters' house spirals out of control.

episodes.title: Punto y coma
episodes.summary: Chloe considers opening up to Eric, while Nico is worried about his cousin's behavior. Omar deals with the consequences of his past in Las Encinas.

episodes.title: La familia
episodes.summary: Sara gets Chloe's help while scheming against Raúl. Omar catches Joel and Iván in an awkward situation. Carmen makes a bold move.

episodes.title: Tocar fondo
episodes.summary: Isadora makes tough decisions in the family business. Luis' investigation is threatened. Deception leaves Chloe in a vulnerable place.

episodes.title: Solo abrázame
episodes.summary: Raúl manipulates Sara's revenge to his advantage. Iván's presence puts Omar and Joel's relationship in a very confusing place.

episodes.title: Voy a acabar con esto para siempre
episodes.summary: A new death shocks the students of Las Encinas. Iván makes a last-minute proposal to Joel, while Isadora must decide what to do with her parents.

episodes.title: Alumni
episodes.summary: Nadia's return surprises Omar. Isadora and Chloe compete for entry into the exclusive and mysterious Alumni, where Joel captures Héctor's attention.

episodes.title: Al extremo
episodes.summary: The rift between Joel and Iván widens as Héctor comes between them. Chloe makes a heartbreaking choice, and Carmen receives a startling message.

episodes.title: Combustión
episodes.summary: A dangerous event raises the stakes for Joel and Isadora, who can't afford to lose the grand prize. Dalmar's scheme further puts him in hot water.

episodes.title: No soy de nadie
episodes.summary: A fiery encounter offers Joel a lucrative new avenue. Chloe lays out a trap. A new foe puts Omar's life on the line. Sara and Nico get closer.

episodes.title: La última noche
episodes.summary: Desperate, Dalmar considers a new strategy as Chloe and Eric devise theirs. Joel shares his secret with Iván. Luis' obsession with Isadora grows.

episodes.title: Culpables
episodes.summary: A shocking murder leads to two arrests. Emilia and Héctor make a plan as Omar conducts his own investigation. Sara learns more about Raúl's death.

episodes.title: Como hermanos
episodes.summary: Héctor and Emilia's bond splits. Nadia urges Omar to report his attackers. As the murder probe proceeds, Iván, Isadora and Sara suspect Chloe and Eric.

episodes.title: Fin de curso
episodes.summary: Isadora takes justice into her own hands. Chloe and Carmen make their final play. When an incriminating video circulates, Las Encinas takes a last hit.
